## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_36_electrician_the_schedule",
  "text": "The schedule is posted. I posted it in the generator housing next to the fuel gauge. The schedule is the load-shed. The schedule says what runs and what does not and when. I wrote it in 2-day decrements because 2 days is the unit of the bunker. The council meets every 2 days. The expeditions go for 2 days. The breaths are 2 days. I wrote the schedule in the units the bunker thinks in. The schedule is not a plan. The schedule is a list of the things the bunker will do without. The first thing the bunker will do without is the mess hall and the laundry. The bunker has already done without the laundry. The Widow's towels are the laundry now. The second thing is the corridor heat. The lower corridor will be 8 degrees. The cast-iron stove is the fallback. The third thing is the grow lights. The LED is the fallback. The wheat survives. The barley does not. The fourth thing is the radio. The hand-crank is the fallback. The bunker listens. The bunker does not speak. The last thing is the medical cold storage and the ventilation. The ventilation goes manual. The cold storage goes passive. The 304 goes to the lower corridor. The schedule is the document that says the bunker will do without and the doing without is the living. I wrote it. I posted it. I stood in the generator housing and I looked at the fuel gauge and the fuel gauge said 135 litres and the schedule said 13 days and I stood there and I did not write a schedule for the day after the 13 days because the schedule does not go past the generator. The schedule is the generator. The generator is the schedule. When the generator stops, the schedule stops, and the bunker does what the schedule said and the doing is the living and the living is the doing without. I am the Electrician. I make things work. I wrote the schedule for the things that will not work. That is the work.",
  "timestamp": "Day 195, 21h",
  "author_name": "The Electrician",
  "author_id": "the_electrician",
  "knowledge_key": "electrician_load_shed_schedule_posted",
  "day": 195,
  "hour": 21.0
}
```

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The posted schedule begins with mess hall and laundry, then corridor heat, grow lights, and radio, with medical cold storage and ventilation last. It lists fallbacks and shows 135 litres of fuel, estimated at thirteen days. The Electrician does not write a schedule beyond generator failure. Do not state that the list has already been fully enacted or invent its outcome. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.
